system.description: Conduits who forge bonds with entities, forces, or powers beyond the material world. They channel bonds into healing and support, then allow a summoned entity to fully manifest.
system.benefit: Gain access to the Calling Combat Skill. If acquired later: gain access to Calling, gain 2 pips in it, then gain one additional Calling Expertise and two additional Calling Action Cards.

origin.name: Greater Manifestation
origin.text: Full Manifestations cost one fewer die than normal, to a minimum cost of 2 dice.
